resources.string: Nothing on the shelf yet — tap New sketch to start one.

帮你Draw helps you draw: a simple, fast sketching and painting app for phones and tablets, made for the S Pen. Fully offline — no permissions, no network, nothing leaves your device except the paintings you keep in your gallery.

Built almost entirely by LLM agents. Public domain (Unlicense).
